newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates steady to lower on call session.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates steady to lower on call session.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were steady to lower on Thursday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No barges traded versus none on Wednesday.
- Five barges, this week, Mississippi (St Paul-Savage), bid 175 percent of tariff, unchanged, no offer.
- Two barges, next week, Illinois river, bid 155 percent, offered 170 percent.
- Two barges, next week, Mid-Mississippi, no bid, offered 175 percent.
- Four barges, one each of week of October, Mid-Mississippi, bid 195 percent down five percentage points, no offer.
- Four barges, two each week of October 20 and 27, Illinois river, bid 195 percent, no offer.
